purpose: BLOCK-24 P1 dev Electron observation of the UI-193 accept/reject widget on the Working Tree Review inline diff (scratch modification to CHANGELOG.md).

rootCause: CodeMirrorDiffView builds DiffRevision { filePath, originalText, modifiedText } without a hunks field; the acceptRejectWidget extension's getHunks() therefore returns [] and mounts no widget decorations. The Working Tree Review accept/reject UX is the BLOCK-20 drawer action bar (header A accept / R reject + pending/accepted/rejected counters), not the BLOCK-22 CodeMirror widget.
disposition: UI-193 remains in_progress: extension implemented and unit-verified; business-path surfacing (populating DiffRevision.hunks or routing accept/reject through the widget) is a product decision outside BLOCK-24's registered ledger/observation scope.
